authorization: User explicitly authorized controlled verification after audit, 2026-11-08
comparison: original same-seed fixed16 vs independent-critic fixed16; original32 retained separately
single_variable: independent critic no longer stopped/rolled back by actor KL; unchanged original actor update called with critic frozen, then critic completes 6 epochs

critic.targets: unchanged rollout GAE returns; no current-actor advantage relabeling
critic.shuffle: local CUDA Generator seed*100000+zero_based_batch; global actor and physical RNG unchanged
critic.timing: after actor updates; new values affect next real rollout
critic.actor_guard: actor weights, means and Adam state bitwise unchanged across value-only fit

resource_rule: same authorized GPU after original queue and sealed pass; two paired seeds if runtime-only aggregate forecast fits, otherwise one; no new-arm or sealed scores used for allocation

selection.score: mean(force_RMS+.03*active_error_cm+cap_fraction)+.25*max(0,max(case_cost-initial_case_cost)); no ratio normalization at near-zero baselines
selection.severe: any physics boundary; active error >initial+max(20cm,.5*initial) or force>initial+2N; short08 root_max_displacement>initial+.10m; none root_max_displacement>initial+.10m
selection.rollback: restore exact best network+Adam; halve nominal actorLR; keep actual sampler state and collect fresh on-policy batch
selection.tie: strict score improvement only; initial always retained

dev.primary: matched fixed16; dev-best retained but never reselected from sealed outcomes

final_rule: one pass frozen P4000 + original same-seed candidate16 + new fixed16, no extension or reselection
not_changed: Current force reward is squared cost, no Gaussian force sigma. Reward sensitivity and phase weighting remain separate hypotheses.
stop: CUDA parity/probability failure; original queue failed; GPU/resource unavailable; insufficient aggregate reserve; no auto retry/new stage
limits: Train-target critic EV is not independent calibration; z angle alone is not task success; one or two paired seeds are limited evidence
